title: Objective 4 Isolated Multi-Container Verification Evidence Bundle (2026-11-18)

synthetic48DirectApi.noteOnQuotedControl: Calling FastAPI POST /check-sync directly bypasses Node server/services/plagiarism.service.js applyExclusions quote/boilerplate stripping, so all 8 quoted_control inputs matched their indexed sources (FP=8, mean composite 63.18%), whereas Node-layer applyExclusions yielded 8/8 TN in the 2026-10-27 lexical control baseline.

defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.defect: reviewSubmissionSchema stripped expectedUpdatedAt during Zod validation, bypassing optimistic concurrency checks.
defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.fix: Added optional/nullable expectedUpdatedAt field to reviewSubmissionSchema so stale reviews return 409 CONCURRENT_REVIEW_CONFLICT.

defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.defect: Approved/indexed submissions synced only MongoDB Winnowing fingerprints and omitted ChromaDB vector indexing via authenticated syncDocumentToPlagiarismEngine.
defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.fix: Wired authenticated ChromaDB sync/removal into indexSubmissionInCorpus, removeSubmissionFromCorpus, and shouldIndexSubmission, and preserved positive lexical fallback scores.

defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.defect: Compiled proposals and final manuscripts self-matched earlier chapters of the same capstone project inside ChromaDB.
defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.fix: Added exclude_project_id filtering in ChromaStore.query_candidates and HST pipeline execution.

defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.defect: Node corpus queries included same-project chapters and rejected/revision-required drafts from other teams, allowing rejected plagiarized submissions to boomerang as false corpus sources.
defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.fix: Excluded same-projectId records and submissions in revisions_required or rejected status from corpus matching.

defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.defect: NOTIFICATION_TYPES enum lacked 8 active notification event types (including evaluation_unlocked, committee_appointed, adm_endorsed), causing Mongoose ValidationError during evaluation unlock (TC-3.3).
defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.fix: Added all 8 missing enum values to NOTIFICATION_TYPES.

defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.defect: publishToADM mapped defense types dynamically without literal midterm/paper keys while DEFENSE_TYPES.MIDTERM='progress' and PAPER='final', misrouting Capstone 2/3 ADM rows to CAPSTONE_1 and clearing global secretary endorsement.
defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.fix: Added explicit midterm: 'CAPSTONE_2' and paper: 'CAPSTONE_3' mappings and scoped secretary endorsement reset per milestone.

defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.defect: tryAutoArchiveProject -> _assertPlagiarismCleared failed with 400 PLAGIARISM_SCORE_REQUIRED because submission.plagiarismResult stores overallScore/originalityScore rather than similarityPercentage.
defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.fix: Normalized similarityPercentage before delegating to assertPlagiarismScanCanClear (preserving plagiarismClearance.js untouched).

defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.defect: BullMQ retained completed/failed plagiarism jobs for 1h/24h under custom jobId plag-${submissionId}, silently deduplicating subsequent manual Archive Re-scan requests.
defectsResolvedDuringLiveVerification.fix: Updated enqueuePlagiarismJob to remove existing completed/failed jobs before queueing the new scan.

methodologicalBoundariesAndNonCertificat: Isolated multi-container verification proves functional, concurrency, RBAC, and outage/recovery behavior in cms_obj4_iso; it is an internal engineering verification and does not constitute third-party ISO/IEC 25010 or ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3 certification.
The live plagiarism container executed EMBEDDING_MODEL=all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-dim CPU runtime fallback) rather than the configured 1024-dim BAAI/bge-m3 GPU model.

Both plagiarism evaluation datasets (n=48 synthetic six-condition cases and n=10 PAN span documents) are bounded synthetic/evaluation corpora rather than an institutional census of historical student theses.
Direct calls to FastAPI POST /check-sync bypass Node's applyExclusions preprocessor and therefore flag quoted_control cases unless routed through the Node submission pipeline.
